keySentence: Everything in Wonderland was very confusing.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Alice went to a tea party. The Mad Hatter asked riddles. Nothing had an answer. Everything in Wonderland was very confusing.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Alice sat down at the Mad Hatter's strange tea party. The Hatter asked riddles that had no answers at all. The March Hare poured tea everywhere and nobody minded. Everything in Wonderland was very confusing and made no sense. Time had stopped at six o'clock and the party never ended. Alice wondered if anything in this world would ever be normal.
